messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Missing cell indices from 6.0 CEL files
parts:
Hi,

I never seen this before. Before digging into the details, I notice
that you do:

chipType <- "GenomeWideSNP_6";
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(dataSet, chipType=chipType);

and not (as suggested in the online 6.0 vignette):

cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType(chipType,tags = 'Full');
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(dataSet, cdf=cdf);

which means that you will not process you data using the full CDF, but
only the default one. You can see from all chip types reported are
'GenomeWideSNP_6' and not 'GenomeWideSNP_6,Full'. Note that:

> cdfF <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byName("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full");
> nbrOfUnits(cdfF)
[1] 1881415
> cdfD <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byName("GenomeWideSNP_6");
> nbrOfUnits(cdfD)
[1] 1856069

The latter count is what aroma.affymetrix "expects". Although I don't
see where the number "710199" (your error message below) comes from,
this could be the source of the problem.


Could it be that you previously already fitted a PLM with the same
output path using the full CDF? In other words, are there already
chip effect files in
plmData/tds2008,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B/GenomeWideSNP_6? What do you
get it if you do:

ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm);
ce <- getFile(ces, 1);
print(ce);


If you didn't, I don't really see why the steps you are doing
shouldn't work with the default GenomeWideSNP_6 CDF. Note that the
neither the UGP nor the UFL file is involved yet. Those gets involved
in the succeeding steps. Then, what can have happened is a clash in
the cache files - you did run a "GenomeWideSNP_6,Full" analysis
previously and now a plain "GenomeWideSNP_6" analysis and somehow the
the memoization (optimization via file cache) picks up previous
results from the former when it works with the latter. To test if
this is the case, go to your ~/.Rcache/aroma.affymetrix/ directory and
delete *all* subdirectories names GenomeWideSNP_6*. It would be great
if you could try this before you switch to cdf=cdf (above). If you
don't get the error after deleting the cache files, it means there is
a bug in the memoization (and your troubleshooting will help me locate
it).

Please let us know how it goes. If possible, I would like to add
additional sanity checks against this.

Cheers

Henrik

messages.subject: Re: Missing cell indices from 6.0 CEL files
parts:
Hi Henrik,

Thanks for your reply. Shortly after sending the post yesterday, I
realised that the cdf=cdf argument was missing from my script. When I
did this, everything worked smoothly (and having discovered my
mistake, I deleted the post). I don't know where the "710199" came
from, although I think I may have tried fitting the probe-level model
a little earlier, but stopped it before it had been fitted to all
groups.

In order to address some of your questions, I had to backtrack, and
remove the cdf=cdf argument, thereby recreating the error messages I
was getting.

So, to run those lines that you suggested. If I don't set cdf=cdf, I
get:

> ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm);
> ce <- getFile(ces, 1);
> print(ce);

CnChipEffectFile:
Name: SNP001_01_M001A
Tags: chipEffects
Pathname: plmData/tds2008,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B/GenomeWideSNP_6/
SNP001_01_M001A,chipEffects.CEL

File size: 26.47MB
RAM: 0.01MB
File format: v4 (binary; XDA)
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,monocell

Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm", mergeStrands: logi TRUE,
combineAlleles: logi TRUE)
If I do set cdf=cdf, I get:

> ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm);
> ce <- getFile(ces, 1);
> print(ce);

CnChipEffectFile:
Name: SNP001_01_M001A
Tags: chipEffects
Pathname: plmData/tds2008,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B/GenomeWideSNP_6/
SNP001_01_M001A,chipEffects.CEL
File size: 26.95MB
RAM: 1.26MB
File format: v4 (binary; XDA)

Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,monocell
Timestamp: 2008-05-26 15:35:00

Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm", mergeStrands: logi TRUE,
combineAlleles: logi TRUE)
As for your suggestion:

"To test if this is the case, go to your ~/.Rcache/aroma.affymetrix/
directory and
delete *all* subdirectories names GenomeWideSNP_6*. It would be great
if you could try this before you switch to cdf=cdf (above)."

After having recreated the error message (by removing cdf=cdf at the
start), I ran:

> plm <- AvgCnPlm(csC, mergeStrands=TRUE, combineAlleles=TRUE, shift=+300)
> print(plm);
AvgCnPlm:
Data set: tds2008
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6
Input tags: ACC,ra,-XY
Output tags: ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B
Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm"; shift: num 300; flavor: chr
"median"; mergeStrands: logi TRUE; combineAlleles: logi TRUE).
Path: plmData/tds2008,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B/GenomeWideSNP_6
RAM: 0.00MB

> fit(plm, verbose = verbose)
Fitting model of class AvgCnPlm:...
AvgCnPlm:
Data set: tds2008
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6
Input tags: ACC,ra,-XY
Output tags: ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B
Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm"; shift: num 300; flavor: chr
"median"; mergeStrands: logi TRUE; combineAlleles: logi TRUE).
Path: plmData/tds2008,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B/GenomeWideSNP_6
RAM: 0.00MB
Identifying non-estimated units...
Error in list("fit(plm, verbose = verbose)" = <environment>,
"fit.ProbeLevelModel(plm, verbose = verbose)" = <environment>, :
[2008-05-27 16:04:27] Exception: Internal error: Expected 1856069 cell

indices, but got 710199.
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Internal error: Expected ", nbrOfUnits, " cell
indices, but
at throw("Internal error: Expected ", nbrOfUnits, " cell indices,
but got ", l
at findUnitsTodo.ChipEffectFile(ce, ...)
at findUnitsTodo(ce, ...)

at fit.ProbeLevelModel(plm, verbose = verbose)
at fit(plm, verbose = verbose)
Identifying non-estimated units...done
Fitting model of class AvgCnPlm:...done

So the error did reoccur without the CDF-related cache files, and I
hope that I've understood correctly that this means that there isn't a
bug in the memorization.

Thanks again,

Jeremy

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Missing cell indices from 6.0 CEL files
parts:
Hi Jeremy,

thanks for the troubleshooting. It is good to know that memoization
[sic!] was not the source of the problem. It seems that pre-existing
chip effect CEL files is the reason. I'll see if I can add some more
sanity checks against this use case.

Cheers

Henrik

On Tue, May 27, 2008 at 7:11 AM, Jeremy Silver <j.si...@biostat.ku.dk> wrote:
>
> Hi Henrik,
>
> Thanks for your reply. Shortly after sending the post yesterday, I
> realised that the cdf=cdf argument was missing from my script. When I
> did this, everything worked smoothly (and having discovered my
> mistake, I deleted the post). I don't know where the "710199" came
> from, although I think I may have tried fitting the probe-level model
> a little earlier, but stopped it before it had been fitted to all
> groups.
>
> In order to address some of your questions, I had to backtrack, and
> remove the cdf=cdf argument, thereby recreating the error messages I
> was getting.
>
> So, to run those lines that you suggested. If I don't set cdf=cdf, I
> get:
>
>> ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm);
>> ce <- getFile(ces, 1);
>> print(ce);
> CnChipEffectFile:
> Name: SNP001_01_M001A
> Tags: chipEffects
> Pathname: plmData/tds2008,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B/GenomeWideSNP_6/
> SNP001_01_M001A,chipEffects.CEL
> File size: 26.47MB
> RAM: 0.01MB
> File format: v4 (binary; XDA)
> Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,monocell
> Timestamp: 2008-05-27 15:44:55
> Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm", mergeStrands: logi TRUE,
> combineAlleles: logi TRUE)
>
> If I do set cdf=cdf, I get:
>
>> ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm);
>> ce <- getFile(ces, 1);
>> print(ce);
> CnChipEffectFile:
> Name: SNP001_01_M001A
> Tags: chipEffects
> Pathname: plmData/tds2008,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B/GenomeWideSNP_6/

> File size: 26.95MB
> RAM: 1.26MB
> File format: v4 (binary; XDA)
> Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,monocell
> Timestamp: 2008-05-26 15:35:00
> Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm", mergeStrands: logi TRUE,
> combineAlleles: logi TRUE)
>
> As for your suggestion:
>
> "To test if this is the case, go to your ~/.Rcache/aroma.affymetrix/
> directory and
> delete *all* subdirectories names GenomeWideSNP_6*. It would be great
> if you could try this before you switch to cdf=cdf (above)."
>
> After having recreated the error message (by removing cdf=cdf at the
> start), I ran:
>
>> plm <- AvgCnPlm(csC, mergeStrands=TRUE, combineAlleles=TRUE, shift=+300)
>> print(plm);
> AvgCnPlm:
> Data set: tds2008
> Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6

> Output tags: ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B

> "median"; mergeStrands: logi TRUE; combineAlleles: logi TRUE).

> On May 26, 9:57 pm, "Henrik Bengtsson" <h...@stat.berkeley.edu> wrote:
>> Hi,
>>
>> I never seen this before. Before digging into the details, I notice
>> that you do:
>>
>> chipType <- "GenomeWideSNP_6";
>> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(dataSet, chipType=chipType);
>>
>> and not (as suggested in the online 6.0 vignette):
>>
>> cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType(chipType,tags = 'Full');
>> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(dataSet, cdf=cdf);
>>
>> which means that you will not process you data using the full CDF, but
>> only the default one. You can see from all chip types reported are
>> 'GenomeWideSNP_6' and not 'GenomeWideSNP_6,Full'. Note that:
>>
>> > cdfF <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byName("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full");
>> > nbrOfUnits(cdfF)
>> [1] 1881415
>> > cdfD <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byName("GenomeWideSNP_6");
>> > nbrOfUnits(cdfD)
>>
>> [1] 1856069
>>
>> The latter count is what aroma.affymetrix "expects". Although I don't
>> see where the number "710199" (your error message below) comes from,
>> this could be the source of the problem.
>>
>> Could it be that you previously already fitted a PLM with the same
>> output path using the full CDF? In other words, are there already
>> chip effect files in
>> plmData/tds2008,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B/GenomeWideSNP_6? What do you
>> get it if you do:
>>
>> ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm);
>> ce <- getFile(ces, 1);
>> print(ce);
>>
>> If you didn't, I don't really see why the steps you are doing
>> shouldn't work with the default GenomeWideSNP_6 CDF. Note that the
>> neither the UGP nor the UFL file is involved yet. Those gets involved
>> in the succeeding steps. Then, what can have happened is a clash in
>> the cache files - you did run a "GenomeWideSNP_6,Full" analysis
>> previously and now a plain "GenomeWideSNP_6" analysis and somehow the
>> the memoization (optimization via file cache) picks up previous
>> results from the former when it works with the latter. To test if
>> this is the case, go to your ~/.Rcache/aroma.affymetrix/ directory and
>> delete *all* subdirectories names GenomeWideSNP_6*. It would be great
>> if you could try this before you switch to cdf=cdf (above). If you
>> don't get the error after deleting the cache files, it means there is
>> a bug in the memoization (and your troubleshooting will help me locate
>> it).
>>
>> Please let us know how it goes. If possible, I would like to add
>> additional sanity checks against this.
>>
>> Cheers
>>
>> Henrik
>>
